query:
SELECT jsonb_path_query_first(
                state,
                '$.revisions[*] ? (@.number == $revision).files[*] ? (@.path == $path).content',
                jsonb_build_object('revision', $2::bigint, 'path', $3::text)
            ) #>> '{}' AS content
            FROM agent_review WHERE agent_session_id = $1
